identity_policy: Placeholder identity; no contact details; all employers and institutions fictional.

facts.zh: 工商管理专科，虚构学习学院 2

facts.en: Retail operations coordinator at Fictional Organization 2
facts.zh: 零售运营协调员，虚构机构 2

facts.en: Coordinated stock transfers among 4 stores using weekly exception reports.
facts.zh: 通过每周异常报告协调 4 家门店间的库存调拨。

facts.zh: 培训 9 名同事维护共享库存工作簿。

facts.zh: 在 3 个月试点中，将每月未解决库存差异由 35 项降至 19 项。

facts.en: Analyzed an original synthetic 5000-row dataset and documented reorder assumptions.
facts.zh: 分析自行构造的 5000 行模拟数据集，并记录补货假设。

grounding.scope: Occupational context only; no source establishes any candidate claim. All case facts and metrics are invented.

generation_policy.allowed: Select, reorder, compress or translate supplied facts without changing meaning.
forbidden: Invent additional metrics, employers, degrees, licenses or dates.
Convert team results into personal sole ownership.
Present synthetic cases as genuine applicants.
generation_policy.missing_information: Ask or omit; never fill from occupational statistics.
